description: Memory utilization percentage. High values indicate memory pressure.
CPU utilization percentage. High values indicate system load.
HTTP status code. 5xx codes indicate server errors.
Error rate as a fraction (0-1). High values indicate system errors.
Average response time in milliseconds. High values indicate performance issues.
Number of requests per second. High values indicate high traffic.
Cache hit ratio (0-1). Low values indicate cache inefficiency.
Database query latency in milliseconds. High values indicate slow queries.
Disk space utilization percentage. High values indicate storage constraints.
Number of database connections. High values indicate database load.
Network latency in milliseconds. High values indicate network issues.
Service availability percentage. Low values indicate outages.
Number of service restarts. High values indicate instability.
